This is also subject to international support in the form of finance, investment, technology development and transfer, and capacity building. "Kenya's INDC includes both mitigation and adaptation components based on her national circumstances and in line with decisions 1/CP.19 and 1/CP.20. "

verdict.text: Kenya pledges a 35% reduction by 2035 against 2035 business-as-usual (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is Kenya's Second Nationally Determined Contribution 2031 - 2035, filed 2025-04-30. 51 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (5). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 99.5 MtCO₂e, DS-02 97.3 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 35% below a business-as-usual projection for 2035. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 39.3 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 30% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to BAU scenario (143 MtCO2eq) It was classed partial. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.93°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.66°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
